title: Ephemeral logging and audit-retention playbook for embeddings + rerank
creator: Camille Ortega
description:
Problem: embeddings and reranking endpoints currently emit debug and audit telemetry that can include user-provided text and derived artifacts (partial embeddings, intermediate similarity scores). Customers and security have requested stronger controls: configurable PII redaction, shorter retention for sensitive logs, and a clear audit event schema for legal/compliance review.

Goal: produce a deployable playbook and implementation that enforces ephemeral logging by default, supports graduated privacy modes (none/minimal/strict/airgap), exposes policy toggles to Dedicated/Private customers, and emits a structured, tamper-evident audit event stream for internal SRE and customer compliance. The solution must preserve the ability to debug production failures (sampling, reproducible hashes) without storing raw PII for more than the configured retention window.

Scope: embeddings.generate and rerank.evaluate endpoints; server-side logging, async audit event pipeline, sampling controls, retention enforcement, and configuration UI in Console for Dedicated customers. Not in scope: upstream model training data, external vector service retention beyond Redwood's pipeline, or third-party partner storage (handled by separate contract).
acceptance_criteria: Default hosted mode logs no raw input text beyond 24 hours and stores only hashed identifiers for 90 days
Configurable privacy modes available: minimal (default), strict (no raw logs, hashed metadata only), airgap (no outbound telemetry)
Audit event schema v1 documented (timestamp, request_id, model_id, privacy_mode, reason_for_sample, hash_of_input, similarity_stats) and published to Confluence
Sampling controls: deterministic hash-based sampling for traceability plus ad-hoc 1:1000 full-text samples gated by security-review flag
Console shows per-route retention and sampling settings for Dedicated customers and allows policy drift detection alerts
implementation_steps: Design telemetry schema and redact/transform rules with Security & Legal
Add privacy_mode config to api gateway for embeddings and rerank routes
Integrate a PII classifier + regex scrubber into request pipeline; produce both redacted_text and hash_of_input
Prevent raw-text persistence in async queues: change queue payloads to reference ephemeral blob ids that expire
Implement retention worker that deletes logs and interim blobs according to tenant policy
Add deterministic sampling hook (sha256(input)%N) and store sampling reason in audit event
Expose policy controls in Console for Dedicated and add UI validation to prevent misconfiguration
Create migration scripts to purge current debug logs older than policy windows and rotate keys used for hashing
E2E tests: simulate rerank failures, verify no raw text in logs when strict mode enabled, validate audit events emitted
